ruleset.name: archon-java-fixture
ruleset.description:
The two PMD rules the fixture is built to trip. Deliberately not a whole category: a fixture that reports dozens of incidental violations makes it impossible to tell whether the rule under test actually fired.
Note the category names. PMD 7 reports a rule reference it cannot resolve as "An XML validation error occurred" at the referencing line, with no indication that the rule simply lives elsewhere now — so a stale category here reads as a malformed file.
